== Biography ==

The Nome King is the former possessor of the Magic Belt, an artifact described as much more powerful than the Silver Shoes. Dorothy once captured this Magic Belt from him, an event she recalls when explaining how Ozma can watch over her through an enchanted picture. The Yellow Hen later recounts having had adventures with the Nome King in the Land of Ev.
